widgets_values:
{"version": 1, "content": "

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the list in the note above.

  • Load Diffusion Model (Qwen Image 2.1) - The image model itself, 7B, from Alibaba's Qwen team.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL 8B) - Reads your prompt and looks at your pictures.
  • Load VAE - Turns pictures into the model's own format and back. It works with four channels, red, green, blue and transparency, which is how this model can hand back a transparent picture.

 The numbers you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you have to touch.

  • 1. Load Image - Scene - The place, here a sunny terrace by the sea. This is the picture being edited. In the prompt it is <image1>.
  • 2. Load Image - Character - The person to place. A full-body photo on a plain background works best. In the prompt it is <image2>.
  • 3. Pick Orientation and Size - The size and shape of the result. Picture 1 always goes to the model whole. Pick the shape closest to it (the terrace picture is square, so 1024 x 1024) and the result lines up with it in the Compare; pick another shape and the model re-frames the picture to fit it. The starred sizes are Qwen's native 2K ones and much slower.
  • 4. Add a prompt - What to make, and what to keep. Name the pictures by their tags.
  • 5. Seed Random/Fixed? - Fixed repeats the same result, Random rolls a new one each Run.

 The speed nodes

Teal, above the graph.

  • Qwen Image 2.1 Cache - Where the model keeps what it has already worked out about your pictures and the prompt, so it does not redo that on every step. Leave it on auto / default. The note in workflow 1 (Outfit Change) says when to change it.
  • Model Attention Backend - Set to comfy kitchen attention, a faster way to do the model's attention maths. It changes the speed, not the picture. On a graphics card that cannot use it, ComfyUI falls back to normal attention by itself.

 The helpers

Purple. They run by themselves.

  • Math Expression - Works out how many megapixels the size from step 3 has, so picture 1 is read at the same number of pixels as the result.
  • Scale Image to Total Pixels - Works out the size picture 1 is read at: that many pixels, in steps of 32, in picture 1's own shape. Only that size is used.
  • Get Image Size - Reads that size as a width and a height for Resize Crop Pixaroma under it.
  • Resize Crop Pixaroma - Scales picture 1 to that size and trims the few pixels that do not fit, so the model gets the whole picture and nothing is stretched.

 The render

Green. These run by themselves.

  • Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1 - Reads your prompt and the pictures. Its resolution is set to 0, which takes the pictures as they come: picture 1 from the helpers, the others at about 1 megapixel from their loaders. Its negative prompt box does nothing at CFG 1, the setting this model is made for, so leave it empty.
  • Empty Latent Image - The blank canvas for the result, at the size from step 3. The encoder's own canvas would always copy picture 1's shape.
  • KSampler - The render: 25 steps, euler, simple, CFG 1, the settings from ComfyUI's own template.
  • VAE Decode - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Image Compare Pixaroma - Picture 1 and the result, one over the other. Move the mouse across it to slide between them.
  • Preview Image Pixaroma - Shows the result and saves it to your output folder as a PNG.

The dark Run Timer above them shows how long the last Run took.

widgets_values:
{"version": 1, "content": "

SETTINGS AND RUN TIME

 What this workflow makes

The scene from picture 1 with the person from picture 2 in it: here, the man in the blue suit standing on the terrace, next to the wicker armchair.

Every number below was measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow and its own settings, each run on a fresh seed with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the cost goes up with the pixels.

 How long a Run takes

What changed1024 x 1024
New pictures or prompt12 s
New seed only9 s

For bigger sizes, see the table in workflow 1 (Outfit Change): native 2K took about five times as long as 1 MP there, and it grows the same way here.

The graphics card peaked at about 19 GB during these runs.

 Writing the prompt

  • The scene comes first because picture 1 is the one being edited: the person is added to it. Any shape works: square, 9:16 and landscape each kept the whole man on the terrace on 4 of 4 seeds, with the terrace re-framed to fit.
  • Say where in the scene the person is and what they are doing, not only that they are there.

Tested on 8 seeds: every one kept his face and suit and the whole terrace, with him standing next to the armchair.

 The other edit workflows

Kitchen attention, the memory node, the first Run of the session and the full size table are explained in workflow 1 (Outfit Change). They work the same way here.
